newsitem.title: USA: U.S. M-2 money supply rose $2.6 bln in Feb 3 week. [CORRECTED 22:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. M-2 money supply rose $2.6 bln in Feb 3 week. [CORRECTED 22:50 GMT]

text.p: U.S. M-2 money supply rose $2.6 billion in the February 3 week to $3,860.8 billion (corrects from $3,850.8 billion), the Federal Reserve said.
The broader M-3 measure rose $8.2 billion to $4,987.5 billion. M-1 rose $4.0 billion to $1,088.0 billion, the Fed said.
The Fed said the four-week moving average of M-2 was $3,853.6 billion versus $3,850.3 billion in the previous week.
